mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM content_photo_album a WHERE a.family_id = #{familyId} AND a.deleted = 1 AND (a.parent_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_photo_album p WHERE p.id = a.parent_id AND p.deleted = 1)) ORDER BY a.deleted_at DESC
SELECT * FROM content_photo_album WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1

SELECT a.id FROM content_photo_album a WHERE a.deleted = 1 AND a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND a.deleted_at < #{cutoff} AND (a.parent_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_photo_album p WHERE p.id = a.parent_id AND p.deleted = 1))
mapper.update: UPDATE content_photo_album SET deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
